operations.name: Angela Nance

expected.charges: Inciting to riot — Tallahassee lunch-counter sit-in
expected.sentence: Sixty days or a $300 fine at the March 17, 1960 trial. Chose jail; correspondence confirms continued confinement at Leon County Jail on April 28. Exact release remains unverified. Priscilla Stephens’s contemporary account dates the eight students’ admission to March 18, 1960.

operations.source: State Archives of Florida, Stephens Sisters Jail-In Papers, 1960: https://www.floridamemory.com/discover/historical_records/stephens_sisters/
